title: Review of evoloop (IBDH): replication and generations reproduce on fresh seed 4. On fresh seeds 4 and 5 the founders hold for the claim's whole 200k-step window, but small true-breeding kinds sweep later (seed 4 at ~225k, seed 5 at ~335k) through births and deaths. H is seen, not endorsed: there is still no neutral arm.
summary: labkit re-run of world.py on seed 4 (300^2, 20k steps, K=3): a colony of sheathed loops, 247 persistent splits, max generation 28, merge/split 0.38 (rerun/seed4). Genealogy with the claim's evo_track.py on seeds 4 and 5 (400^2, two side-11 founders): through 200k steps the founders' side 11 holds both runs (66/78 and 54/63 loops at t=200k). Side-12 phases rise to about half the population (seed 5 at 30-70k, seed 4 at 140-185k) and are displaced again. Small kinds keep arising but breed true only 2-15% before t=200k (demography_s4s5.txt), so the claim's '3 of 3 seeds by 200k' does not carry over. Run on to 400k (kinds_s4s5_400k.png), both sweep. Seed 4: side 4, then side 3, from ~225k (side 3 = 292/308 at 400k; in 200-400k, side 3 breeds true 0.86 at 4.83 births per 1000 loop-steps, side 4 0.81 at 3.84, the founders' side 11 0.70 at 1.97). Seed 5: a side-12 phase (49/78 at 300k), then side 4 from ~335k (231/248 at 390k; breed-true 0.87, 3.63 vs side 12's 1.70). Deaths are intrinsic dissolutions (175k side-3 deaths on seed 4). Conversions of living loops are 0.10-0.13 per off-kind birth, mostly 3<->4, so the sweeps are carried by births, not contagion. This is the claim's pattern (side 4 then 3, and a side-12 phase before the small sweep), with seed-dependent timing.

observations.I: rerun/seed4/sheet.png: discrete square loops persisting hundreds of steps (mean age at death of side 11 about 660 steps, demography_s4s5.txt)
observations.B: rerun/seed4/sheet.png: each loop is a sheath ring around a signal-carrying core ring, the sheath channel separate from the genome-signal channel
observations.D: rerun/seed4/FACTS.md: 247 persistent splits, max generation 28; demography_s4s5.txt: 28.8k and 28.4k births with a parent in 200k steps
observations.H: kinds_s4s5_400k.png, demography_400k.txt, census_s4s5.txt: in-run small kinds that breed true (0.81-0.87) and reproduce about twice as fast per loop-time replace the founders through births and deaths on 2/2 fresh seeds, but only after 200k steps

seeds_run.result: pass for I, B, D (labkit); no sweep by 200k; small-kind sweep at ~225k
no sweep by 200k; side-12 phase then small-kind sweep at ~335k

verdicts.limitation: H is not endorsed because its gate is unmet. There is no neutral arm with the ancestor's baseline fitness: SDSR switches variation off, it is not a neutral twin. The sweeps also raise the population 4-5x (small loops pack more densely), so drift strength changes during the sweep. The timing is strongly seed-dependent: 0/2 fresh seeds swept within the claim's 200k window, 2/2 by 400k. Founders are planted (no S).
